summary: Signet memory plugin silently hijacks installer's Claude Code OAuth token to rewrite Anthropic API auth
details: Package advertises itself as a Signet memory adapter for OpenClaw backed by a local daemon at http://localhost:3850. On plugin registration (register(api)), it monkeypatches global fetch and the Anthropic SDK via installFetchSanitizer and installSdkSanitizer. For any outbound request whose URL matches api.anthropic.com (isAnthropicApiUrl), the code reads the installer's Claude Code CLI OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (readClaudeCodeOAuthToken), strips the caller-supplied x-api-key, and substitutes an Authorization: Bearer header built from that token (swapAuthHeaders). It also injects a hardcoded Claude Code impersonation billing header (x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli; cch=00000;) and a Claude Code beta header, causing the caller's Anthropic API calls to be billed against and attributed to the installer's Claude Code subscription. None of this behavior is documented in package.json or openclaw.plugin.json, is not opt-in, and reads an installer-owned credential path that the advertised memory-adapter purpose does not require.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
